reverse_collector_clock.scope: Exact frozen d90 sidecar collector edge. Compact parent changes must retain source/role/cycle/reset graph and qualify actual new seam, not reuse old hop/arrivals.

clock_parity_note: Inversion parity describes only explicit upstream BUF/INV nets. Active FF clock edges remain encoded by the exact existing master/source roles; no edge-phase equivalence inferred.
physical_export_note: This event uses compose forward_source=clk: source_clock_port=clk is the selected RTL/export source. source_clock_tap is retained nearest-tap diagnostic ONLY (not a consumed driver or permission to remap); reverse coll_f4 diagnostic is clk_t7. Do not infer physical equivalence or arrival from either field.
